sql: /* Query 6: 3 (team) */ SELECT ownership, founded_year, championship FROM team WHERE ownership <> 'Herb Simon' OR championship = 3

championship.description: championships is the number of this team getting championships (e.g. 5).

founded_year.description: founded_year is the year of this team team founded (e.g. 1947).

ownership.description: ownership is the name of the team's owner (e.g. Jeanie Buss).
